privacy.title: Privacy Policy · onholdlab
privacy.description: What onholdlab collects from the website and works, how it is used, and how to delete it.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.scope: This applies to the homepage, games and tools under onholdlab.github.io. We only collect what the works need to run. We don't sell data and don't use ad trackers.
privacy.statistics.heading: Visit statistics (GoatCounter)
privacy.statistics.collectedData: We use GoatCounter to count page views. It records the page address, the site you came from, browser and device type, screen size, and approximate country.
privacy.statistics.noCookies: It uses no cookies, builds no profiles, and isn't used to identify you.
privacy.feedback.heading: Feedback form
privacy.feedback.collectedData: Your message, the contact you choose to leave (email or IG), and the page address and browser info at the time you send it.
privacy.feedback.purpose: Used only to read feedback and reply to you. Stored in a Supabase database that only we can read.
privacy.leaderboards.heading: Game leaderboards
privacy.leaderboards.collectedData: The nickname you enter, your score, upload time, and a randomly generated device code (used only to count one entry per device).
privacy.leaderboards.publicNotice: Leaderboards are public: every player can see nicknames and scores. Please don't use your real name or private details as a nickname.
privacy.browserStorage.heading: Data stored in your browser
privacy.browserStorage.collectedData: Language choice, nickname, best scores, game settings, homepage mini-game progress, and the device code above.
privacy.browserStorage.deletion: These stay in your own browser (localStorage) and are removed when you clear site data.
privacy.microphone.heading: Microphone (Clapping Cat)
privacy.microphone.browserRecognition: Clapping Cat asks for the microphone and uses your browser's built-in speech recognition to hear the trigger words. We don't record or store audio.
privacy.microphone.provider: Speech recognition is provided by the browser. Chrome, for example, sends it to Google, under the browser maker's policy.
privacy.services.heading: Other services
privacy.services.providers: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Some pages load fonts and scripts from Google Fonts and cdnjs, and some games are also on itch.io. These services handle connection data (such as IP addresses) under their own policies.
privacy.deletion.heading: Questions or deletion
privacy.deletion.contact: Use the feedback form on the homepage or DM @onholdlab on Instagram and tell us which message or leaderboard nickname to delete.
privacy.deletion.updates: If this policy changes, we'll update this page and the date above.
